svg.title: Turbo Flow — every feature, one map
svg.text: a developer tool — the rules layer (rig-lite) for AI-written code
180+★ · MIT · bash + python3 — no daemons, no lock-in
verdict counts only at the head it gated — new commits make the PR ungated again; --sweep re-gates (stale-approval fix)
round cap: 3 gate rounds per PR, then exit 4 — the continue / park fork goes to a human
the reviewer is NEVER from the builder's model family
lint · tests · types run before a single token is spent
ambiguous, errored, or spoofed output is REVISE
gated-head pin + commit status on the exact SHA reviewed
only defects this diff introduces can block — the rest are notes
past the cap: exit 4 — continue / park / restructure is a human call
round 2+ sees prior findings as scrubbed DATA — no re-litigating
every verdict lands in local JSONL; PR mode posts + sets the status
THE LOOP — every change, no exceptions
GATE: REVISE → fix & re-gate · APPROVED → your move · no verdict = REVISE
branch protection makes gate-verdict REQUIRED — main can't take an un-gated
gate-check.yml re-checks every push; when APPROVED lands, it flips the PR's
fork PRs get the exact one-click re-run — GitHub won't link their runs, so
--require-review demands an approving review (an account permission) —
human-only merging is access control, and the docs say so
parallel agents never share a working tree
never in git, never in ps
one fact per file + an inbox; the loop feeds
merge queue + gate verdicts + merged PRs
the whole kit, one verb set
gate · wt · test · digest · secrets · tokens
spec/UAT templates · deletion guard prints loud
fake reviewer CLIs drive the REAL invoke path
no test hooks in the gate
the laws, shipped with the kit
secrets never touch git · ask the human
6. Verdicts parseable or they don't exist
8. State on disk, not in chat
9. When in doubt, ask the human
the full stack: 215+ MCP tools, 60+ agents
MIT · every verdict + evidence lives in the PR · merges, money, and the occasional round-4 ruling stay human
